sloka: जगृहुः पादपांश्चापि पुष्पितान् वानरर्षभाः ।शिलाश्च विपुला दीर्घा योद्धुकामाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ६.५८.९ ।।।।
transliteration: jagṛhuḥ pādapāṁścāpi puṣpitān vānararṣabhāḥ ।śilāśca vipulā dīrghā yoddhukāmāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 6.58.9 ।।।।

translations.english: The Vanaras burning with desire to fight, for their part went with huge trees in bloom, huge and long rocks.
